en.t: The Kawana Hotel was splendid and magnificent.

units.source_text: 翌日清晨，我又去邀大竹七段。

en.t: Early the next morning, I went again to invite Otake 7-dan.

units.source_text: 也是出于一片好心，我想，要是能消除七段那股别扭劲儿就好了。

en.t: It was also done out of goodwill; I thought it would be good if I could dispel that awkwardness in the 7-dan.

units.source_text: 我也邀请了日本棋院的八幡干事和《东京日日新闻》的砂田记者一同前往。

en.t: I also invited Secretary Yawata of the Nihon Ki-in and reporter Sunada of the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun to go with us.

units.source_text: 我们白天在饭店庭院农村风味的房子里吃寿喜烧，一直笑谈到傍晚。

en.t: During the day, we ate sukiyaki in a rustic-style house in the hotel garden and kept laughing and chatting until evening.

units.source_text: 从前我曾应舞蹈家们和大仓喜七郎的邀请，来过川奈饭店，自己也曾来过，可以当向导。

en.t: In the past I had come to the Kawana Hotel at the invitation of dancers and Okura Kichichiro, and I had also come on my own, so I could serve as a guide.
